title: Field Excellence Lead - Account Management & New Launches (Immunology)
description:
About This Role:
The Field Excellence Lead for New Products & Account Management is the catalyst who designs the field operational launch roadmap, with a focus on the new or upgraded operational capabilities which will be critical to launch success. The immediate focus will be preparing for the Lupus launch, a launch that will require the development of a Strategic Account Management operational capability. This will also lay the foundation for Nephrology, the next Therapeutic Area on Biogen ’s launch roadmap. You will be the Operational Architect and critical connective tissue between Franchise Launch Strategy and Field Execution. While subject matter experts (SMEs) lead the development of Incentive Compensation, Call Plans, Field Analytics and Field Technology, this is the key leader who pulls these disparate pillars together into a single, cohesive "Standard of Excellence." After launch, you will proactively monitor field execution: creating action plans based on analytics-backed insights on key success factors, mining for field-generated best practices, and removing obstacles to optimal execution.
What You’ll Do:

• Design and execute the Launch Operational Plan, architecting and implementing a robust Strategic Account Management capability for Lupus & Nephrology launches.

• Proactively monitor field execution to identify operational barriers and best practices, translating insights into scalable action plans.

• Establish and monitor a Launch Brand Operational Annual Roadmap with clear KPIs, deliverable milestones, and governance decision-making.

• Architect and implement a robust Strategic Account Management capability to shift from transactional selling to enterprise-level partnerships.

• Act as the central clearinghouse for field force excellence innovation and maintain routine cadence of launch optimization feedback sessions.

• Influence Franchise Heads and Sales VPs using data and field credibility to drive adoption of new operational initiatives.

• Provide strategic input for the annual Brand Plan regarding field execution, emphasizing critical opportunities and barriers.

• Identify high-level skill gaps in the field force and partner with commercial learning for targeted interventions.

• Establish operational milestones for the year, including recurring tasks and special projects.

• Develop quarterly deliverables for future launches, including Franchise Opportunity Playbooks, Execution Gap Assessments, Operational Assessments, and QBRs.

Who You Are:
You possess a strategic vision and anticipate future trends impacting customer engagement. Your analytical skills allow you to navigate complex data sets, extracting actionable field insights. You have an innovative mindset, always ready to challenge the status quo, and excel at influencing stakeholders without direct authority. You have a proven track record of driving adoption through effective communication and training.
Location:
There is a strong preference for talent within a commutable distance to Cambridge MA to consider applying, however for the right set of skills and experience we will consider Remote (US only). Travel to the office 1x per month is required for Remote talent.
Required Skills:

• Bachelor's degree with 12+ years of progressive experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotech industry.

• Must have significant experience in Commercial Operations or Sales Excellence leadership, with a strong preference for immunology therapeutic area experience.

• Proven track record in a Launch-Phase Field Leadership role (e.g., Division Sales Manager, Regional Sales Director, or National Sales Lead).

• Experience designing and/or working in a Strategic Account Management team.

• Ability to anticipate future trends and plan proactively.

• Comfortable navigating complex data for actionable insights.

• Mastery in influencing disparate stakeholders toward common operational goals.

• Willingness to challenge traditional models and drive innovation.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Belfast, United Kingdom
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Principal, CX Strategy & Analytics
tags: Customer Success : Customer Success Operations : Customer Experience
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

At Toast, we are passionate about creating raving fans and delivering an unparalleled customer experience. And we see the service and support that our team provides to customers as a key differentiator in the market and a point of pride. As Toast continues to grow - offering new products, serving new customer types & segments, expanding to new geographies - we must continue to innovate on that customer experience and the level, type and modes of support we provide.

As Principal, Customer Experience Strategy & Analytics, you'll play a critical role in shaping how we improve the experience for every customer. As more customers join Toast, that experience has to scale without losing what makes it great. You'll own the Voice of the Customer program across SMB, International and Retail, and you'll stay close to what customers and the Toasters who serve them are saying. With that insight, you'll help us meet customers where they are, fix what's causing pain, and drive business outcomes by making the Toast experience a reason customers choose us and stay.

You'll inherit a solid foundation for measuring customer health. You'll run and interpret NPS, CSAT, CES and other key CX metrics with care, keeping them accurate and consistent, while finding ways to make them better. You'll dig into why customers feel the way they do and turn that into clear priorities for cross-functional improvements. You'll also modernize how the work gets done, cutting manual analysis and bringing in smarter tools, without losing the sharp judgment and thoughtful recommendations our teams count on.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Customer Experience and is a high priority, high visibility position in the Customer Success organization. You will join other high-impact individuals shaping the future customer experience and journey across all customer segments at Toast.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Own the ongoing quantitative and qualitative analysis and reporting for Voice of the Customer programs, responsible for identifying, validating and storytelling the top operational drivers of customer sentiment and recommending solutions to address customer pain and optimize NPS, Toast’s CX beacon metric

• Listen to customers directly and often, through interviews, call and chat reviews, survey verbatims and site visits, to build a firsthand understanding of the experience behind the metrics

• Own the ongoing maintenance of key Customer Experience metrics (e.g. NPS/CSAT/CES) to ensure optimal deployment on par with industry best practices

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve the Toast customer experience by monitoring and analyzing CX and business metrics, alongside customer verbatims and frontline feedback, with a keen focus on the root cause of customer pain.

• Deliver clear and compelling data-driven storytelling, grounded in real customer voices, that builds empathy for the customer, helps teams understand how and why to act, and influences cross-functional partners to prioritize solutions to address the customer need

• Maintain an ongoing understanding of business priorities and challenges to ensure CX priorities are in service of priority organizational goals and needs

• Partner with cross-functional teams (Customer Marketing, Service Design, UX Research, R&D, Customer Success) to create customer experience solutions that are feasible and holistic 

• Build strong listening channels with cross-functional and frontline partners (Care, Account Management, Sales, Onboarding, Product) to capture what they hear from customers, spot emerging issues early, and close the loop on what changed as a result

• Define and implement Toast-wide programs to inspire customer-centric decision making at every level through processes

title: Ingénieur·e de recherche et développement en Programmation par Contraintes
locationText: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France
description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.
Au sein du Département Automatique, Productique et Informatique, le poste sera associé à l’équipe TASC (Théorie, Algorithmes et Systèmes en Contraintes ) dont les thématiques de recherche s’articulent autour de la programmation par contraintes, de la théorie aux applications en passant par l’hybridation. Dans ce cadre, le poste a pour objectif de venir en soutien au développement du solveur de contraintes choco-solver ( http://choco-solver.org ) maintenu par l’équipe TASC.

MISSIONS
Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle du responsable du projet et développeur principal de la plateforme Choco-solver et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe TASC, les missions principales du poste sont :

• Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur, telles que GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort ou Circuit ;

• Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes (p. ex. le moteur de propagation) ;

• Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (lazy) dans les contraintes Sum et AllDifferent, entre autres ;

• Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets.

ACTIVITÉS : Activité par mission

• Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur

· Analyse les algorithmes de filtrage de GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort et Circuit disponibles dans choco-solver et identifie les parcours en profondeur (composantes fortement connexes, chemins alternants, etc.) susceptibles de bénéficier de l’approche bimodale
· Conçoit et implémente en Java les variantes bimodales de ces algorithmes, en garantissant le niveau de cohérence attendu
· Vérifie la correction des implémentations par des tests unitaires et des tests aléatoires comparant les résultats avec les propagateurs existants
· Mesure les gains obtenus (temps de filtrage, passage à l’échelle) sur des jeux d’instances de référence (XCSP3, MiniZinc Challenge)
· Intègre les développements validés dans la version publique de choco-solver (revue de code, documentation, intégration continue)

2. Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes
· Étudie le fonctionnement interne de choco-solver (moteur de propagation, ordonnancement des propagateurs, gestion des événements) afin d’identifier les mécanismes pouvant tirer parti d’une stratégie bimodale
· Propose et prototype une ou plusieurs adaptations, par exemple un basculement dynamique entre modes de propagation
· Évalue expérimentalement ces prototypes et analyse les compromis entre coût et bénéfice

3. Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (
· Implémente ou étend la génération paresseuse d’explications pour les contraintes Sum, AllDifferent et d’autres contraintes globales
· Compare les explications paresseuses aux explications calculées pendant la propagation (taille des clauses apprises, temps de résolution, nombre de nœuds explorés)
· Conçoit et conduit un protocole expérimental reproductible, puis analyse et synthétise les résultats

4. Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets.
· Rédige en anglais des articles scientifiques présentant les contributions, en vue de soumissions à des conférences (CP, IJCAI, AAAI, CPAIOR) ou revues (Constraints) internationales
· Prépare les artefacts expérimentaux associés (code, scripts, données) afin d’assurer la reproductibilité des résultats
· Présente les travaux en séminaire d’équipe et, le cas échéant, en conférence

FORMATION ET COMPÉTENCES :
Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :
· Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent
· Dip

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

- Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. These are the two metrics that define success in this role

- Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

- Partner with the Enterprise Sales Lead to turn warm introductions into qualified opportunities and closed deals

- Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workfl

title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Vor zwei Jahren hätten wir hier einen „TypeScript-Ninja" gesucht. Tiefes technisches Können zählt heute mehr denn je - geändert hat sich nur der Engpass. Es geht nicht mehr darum, wie schnell du tippst, sondern wie gut du beurteilen kannst, was ein Agent produziert. Das Schreiben der Zeilen wird billig; zu wissen, wie gute Software aussieht - saubere Typen, OOP da wo sie trägt, eine Architektur, die hält -, wird zur entscheidenden Fähigkeit.
Dazu kommt, was vor und nach dem Code liegt: ein Gespür dafür, was das Produkt wirklich besser macht, und die Fähigkeit, Agents so zu dirigieren, dass am Ende etwas Tragfähiges entsteht. Wir nennen diese Rolle Product Engineer - jemand, der ein Stück Produkt von der Idee bis in Production besitzt, nicht jemand, der Tickets abarbeitet. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, entscheidest über die Lösung, baust sie mit Agents, verifizierst sie und shippst. Diese Stelle füllst du nicht aus, du prägst sie mit.
Über Orbit

Orbit ist das AI-first Logistics Operating System: eine modulare, API-getriebene Cloud-Plattform für die gesamte Transportlogistik. Auftragseingang, Tourenplanung, Carrier-Management, Fahrer-App, Auftragsverfolgung, Dokumentenmanagement - alles aus einem Guss und durchautomatisierbar. Wir lösen nicht ein Teilproblem, wir ersetzen das gesamte operative Fundament.
Orbit ist überall zuhause, wo Transportprozesse geplant, beauftragt oder durchgeführt werden - bei mittelständischen Logistikern ebenso wie bei Großkonzernen, die ihre Supply Chain neu denken.
Warum Logistik? Weil wir keine Software für Banker in der Londoner City oder Marketer in New York bauen, sondern dafür sorgen, dass sich in der echten Welt tatsächlich etwas bewegt. Alles war mal in einem LKW - der Stuhl auf dem du sitzt genauso wie der Bildschirm, auf den du gerade schaust.
Wir sind bootstrapped und profitabel. Was wir bis hierhin erreicht haben, haben wir aus eigener Kraft gebaut, mit außergewöhnlichen Zahlen in einem Markt voller venture-finanzierter Wettbewerber. Unsere Kunden bleiben, weil das Produkt hält, was es verspricht. Und wir fangen gerade erst an.
Software. Done right. Wir nehmen Software als Handwerk ernst. Jede Zeile Code, jede Kundenintegration, jedes Feature wird mit dem Anspruch gebaut, dass es hält - keine Quick-and-Dirty-Lösungen, kein Feature-Factory-Modus. Daran ändert Agentic Development nichts. Ob ein Agent etwas Tragfähiges produziert oder Tech Debt am Fließband, entscheidet das tiefe Verständnis von gutem Design, sauberen Typen und Architektur. Wer mit Agents arbeitet, muss noch klarer denken.
Aufgaben
Dein Kernauftrag: Ein Stück Orbit von der Idee bis in Production besitzen - und unser Team mit jedem Projekt schneller machen.
Produkt bauen & Features ownen (~65%)
Du baust Features nicht nur, du besitzt sie: die Lösung entscheiden, sie sauber bauen, in Production bringen, an Feedback iterieren und für ihren Erfolg geradestehen. Wir haben einen funktionierenden Flow mit Kanban-Backlog, Produktanalytics und klaren Prioritäten, in den du dich einklinkst. Du arbeitest ihn nicht nur ab, sondern bringst eigene Ideen ein und entscheidest mit, was es wert ist, gebaut zu werden.

• Features von der Idee bis zum Go-Live verantworten, inklusive UX, Edge Cases und der Frage „hält das in der Realität?"

• Eigene Ideen einbringen und vertreten. Du bist meinungsstark dazu, was das Produkt besser macht, nicht nur dazu, wie man es baut.

• Ein Gespür für die User entwickeln, über das Produkt, die Daten und unsere Analytics statt über endlose Calls.

• Technische Entscheidungen treffen und vertreten: Datenmodelle, API-Design, Trade-offs.

Mit Agents bauen & das Harness weiterentwickeln (~20%)
Du arbeitest nicht gegen einen leeren Editor, sondern orchestrierst Agents gegen strukturierte Specs und persistenten Projektkontext - und baust das Werkzeug, das genau das möglich macht, aktiv mit aus.

• Spec-driven Agentic Development: recherchieren, planen, von Agents ausführen lassen, verifizieren, iterieren - mit Qualit

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? title: Internship - Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Smule has been on a mission to bring the world together through music since 2008. Music is much more than listening… it's about creating, sharing, discovering, participating, and connecting with people. With dozens of millions of monthly active users creating over 20 million songs every day, Smule is connecting people all over the world through the joy of making music and transforming the music landscape from one of passive listening to collaborative creative expression and active engagement.
About the Role:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own the end-to-end lifecycle of ML models in production at Smule, from training and optimization through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You will work closely with research scientists to bring models off the bench and into scalable, reliable systems that serve millions of users. The ideal candidate is a strong engineer first, with deep practical knowledge of ML systems, a passion for reliability, and an eye for performance.
We strongly encourage candidates with non-traditional backgrounds to apply. If your path into ML engineering came through backend systems, DevOps, audio software, data engineering, or another field, we want to hear from you.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Design, build, and maintain production ML pipelines encompassing data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment.

• Optimize models for production constraints including latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost, using techniques such as quantization, distillation, pruning, and efficient serving architectures.

• Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for deployed models, covering data drift, prediction quality, and system health.

• Collaborate with research scientists to integrate new model architectures and training techniques into production systems with minimal friction.

• Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for ML, including automated testing, validation gates, and staged rollouts.

• Manage compute infrastructure and costs, making informed tradeoffs between performance, reliability, and budget.

What We're Looking For:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or currently pursuing one.

• Strong proficiency in Python and experience with deep learning serving (TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, or equivalent).

• Solid understanding of systems engineering: networking, storage, containerization, orchestration, and monitoring.

• Ability to reason about tradeoffs between latency, throughput, cost, and model quality.

Bonus Points For:

• Experience serving large language models or other generative models at scale.

• Familiarity with audio/music processing pipelines and real-time inference constraints.

• Experience with Bayesian optimization, bandit algorithms, or adaptive experimentation platforms.

• Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure projects.

title: Network Infrastructure Lead
description:
About the Role

Lead OpenAI’s site network infrastructure delivery, coordinating the physical installation and readiness of network systems with the central network team and contracted installation providers.

You will be OpenAI’s accountable on-site lead for physical network infrastructure construction and deployment, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline. You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan.

Reporting and scope

Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership. Maintain functional alignment with the Network Infrastructure leader and central network engineering team.

Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority. Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners.

This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead. Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages. Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage structured-cabling contractors, fiber installers, network installation partners and other service providers against the site delivery plan.

- Translate approved network designs into executable field packages and coordinate bills of materials, material availability and installation sequencing with the central network team.

- Oversee pathways, duct banks and building-entry interfaces, fiber and copper cabling, racks, patching, labeling and network-equipment installation as applicable.

- Direct fiber and cabling quality assurance, review test results and traceability, and drive correction of defective or incomplete installations.

- Coordinate power, cooling, space and physical access readiness with electrical, mechanical and CSLA leads and hardware deployment teams.

- Coordinate network provisioning, connectivity validation and handover with authorized network engineering and operations teams; maintain accurate installation and as-built records.

- Set clear contractor deliverables and work priorities; review staffing, progress and quality, identify constraints early, and drive recovery actions through the Site Construction Manager.

- Provide concise progress and risk reporting, evaluate field impacts of proposed changes, and maintain accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams.

Qualifications

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you'll do

The Release, Environments and Change Engineer (REC Engineer) has three key areas of responsibility. You will operate Release, Environments and Change processes and procedures, and you’ll be involved in, and often lead, the identification and implementation of process improvements using AI and other tools.

You will work closely with the REC Manager and Environments Manager and operate the processes they define. These processes may rely on manual activities and controls at first, so you’ll take a leading role in replacing them with appropriate automation, and then identify mechanisms and methods to govern those automated controls.

You will collaborate with Enablement teams and engineering teams across Kaluza to make sure processes are understood, embedded and followed. You’ll be a decision maker with the authority to decline or postpone releases and changes, and you’ll handle client communication where approval is required for a change or release.

- Operating promotion gates, making promote or block decisions between environments in line with contractual and ways-of-working agreements, and escalating high-risk calls.

- Maintaining complete, accurate change and configuration records, keeping every change traceable across the full environment stack, and managing the change and release calendar.

- Building and maintaining release automation, including readiness checks, artefact promotion, AI-drafted release notes and notifications, and reporting feeds.

- Working with engineering teams in real time to roll back failed releases or apply fixes, and coordinating with incident and problem management so planned changes, hotfixes and major incidents stay in sync.

- Communicating changes and releases internally and externally, supporting environment coordination and validation, running post-implementation reviews and retros, and giving operational input into gate definitions and the wider process.

What you’ll bring 

- Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple moving parts and spot incomplete records or inconsistencies.

- Clear communication and strong facilitation skills, comfortable coordinating across teams, leading check-ins, keeping everyone aligned, driving decisions and chasing things through to completion.

- The confidence to say no and hold the line when something isn’t ready, and to escalate when you’re unsure.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape the future of our modelling products at Cohere. In this role, you will design intuitive experiences for complex workflows, working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and user needs.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and the ML team, owning the end-to-end design process and acting as a key stakeholder in prioritization and strategy decisions.

- Communication Skills: Clear, proactive communication that keeps distributed teams aligned. You document decisions, articulate design rationale to diverse audiences, and create shared understanding across geographies and disciplines.

title: Policy Director and Counsel, Media and Technology
description:
Our Media & Technology team fights for a democracy where technology and media empower every person to participate fully, freely, and equally, and where every community has trustworthy, locally rooted sources of information. We defend digital rights and civil freedoms, demand transparency and accountability from platforms and tech companies, and work to revitalize the media and information ecosystems communities depend on. Alongside Common Cause’s state teams and partners nationwide, we pair legislative advocacy in statehouses and Congress with coalition-building that holds technology and media institutions accountable to the public. And we’re growing, including a new workstream on AI transparency and accountability at the state, multi-state, and federal levels. 
As Policy Director & Counsel, you’ll be at the center of that work. You’ll bring policy, legal, and strategic insight to teams across the organization, lead research that sharpens our positions and strengthens our campaigns, and help carry out our issues to policymakers, partners, and the public. This is a full-time role reporting to the Senior Policy Director, Media & Technology. It’s remote-eligible anywhere in the lower 48 United States, though we strongly prefer a candidate based in the DC area who can work from our office at least two days a week. Applications received by Monday, November 16 will be given priority consideration, and we hope our new Policy Director & Counsel can start in February.  
Responsibilities 
Lead development of proactive state, multi-state, and federal policy and legal strategies within the Media & Technology pillar, anticipating emerging threats and opportunities 

 
Common Cause is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of any race, creed, color, religion, ethnicity, national origin, income class, political affiliation, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or marital status, as well as applicants who have been previously incarcerated.

Founded in 1970 and headquartered in Washington, DC, Common Cause has members and supporters living in every congressional district in the United States, and offices in 23 states around the country.

KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.

This role partners closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Global Mobility, external consultants, and benefit vendors to ensure programs are delivered effectively, remain compliant with local requirements, and align with the Company's total rewards strategy. title: Senior System Software Engineer - Scientific Computing PaaS
description:
We are seeking a Sr System Software Engineer to help us build out our scientific computing platform workflows on Cloud. This Cloud based scientific computing cloud platform enables Physics based Numerical Simulation Solvers, AI based Training, Inference and Visualization workflow for physical science and engineering problems.

Those applications include Weather prediction, Climate modeling, Industrial design and Digital twins simulation in various domains e.g Aerospace, Automotive, Sports, Renewable energy, Bio-medical and many more. Are you passionate about solving rewarding problems at scale? Do you enjoy crafting robust, critical services for compute and data intensive workload? If so, you may be a phenomenal fit for our team!

What you’ll be doing:

• Design services and take ownership of underlying cloud infrastructure for physics informed and data driven scientific workflows

• Design novel algorithms and actively engage with operations to increase overall system performance, it spans across the stack e.g. deep understanding of application code e.g DL Framework, Numerical Solvers, Microservices, APIs and Heterogeneous accelerated computing with CPUs and GPUs.

• Design, Build, Deploy and Operate scalable I/O infrastructure for checkpointing, data loading, pre & post processing of data.

• Optimize compute, storage and network architecture specific to physics & simulation driven applications.

What we need to see:

• BS/MS degree in Computer Science or related areas or equivalent experience.

• 10+ years experience working on building and operating distributed compute and data intensive platform as a service on cloud

• Proven skill in a compiled language (Go, Rust, C++ or otherwise).

• Strong foundational knowledge in Cloud Computing e.g “The Datacenter is a Computer” architecture, cloud security architecture, virtualization - CPU, Memory and IO, Resource pooling and elasticity.

• Proven skills in Distributed Systems & Parallel Processing e.g System model of distributed computation e.g. topology abstraction, logical time. Synchronization and deadlock detection in distributed systems, Fault Tolerance and Failure Detection, Consensus and Agreement protocols, Parallel algorithms, shared memory and distributed memory architecture, message passing (MPI, NCCL), Cluster scalability and performance.

• Hands on Debugging skills with Process, Threads , Deadlock and Synchronization, Scheduling, IPC, Memory management, File system and I/O structure.

• Strong Evidence on Algorithmic Thinking & System Design skills e.g Recursion, Graph, Tree, Stack and Queue, Large scale loosely coupled distributed system design and operational experience.

• Be self-motivated, have strong interpersonal skills, and be able to work independently with multiple teams with minimal direction.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Have built , deployed and operated AI platforms on HPC clusters. Have built, deployed and operated cloud native system including distributed storage, scheduling, and orchestration among compute, storage and network

• Configuring and troubleshooting hardware, operating systems, kernel, compilers for maximum performance

• Hands on debugging skills to optimize performance of compute, networking and I/O framework. Extensively worked on third party source code for debugging and customization

title: VP of Finance and Accounting
description:
About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities - and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

Role Overview

Kasa is seeking a visionary, systems-oriented Vice President of Finance to serve as the company’s top financial leader, reporting directly to the CEO. The mandate of the role is to build a high-precision finance engine that can support Kasa’s continued growth across a complex hospitality and real estate platform.

The VP of Finance will lead a global team of ~25 across the U.S., Mexico, and the Philippines and will transform the function into a faster, more automated, and more insightful function while maintaining best-in-class reporting accuracy for property owners and investors.

The priorities of this role are to:

• Ensure accurate financial reporting across all entities and properties

• Deliver predictable close and owner reporting cycles

• Elevate the depth and value of financial reporting, including balance sheet, cash flow, and KPI segmentation

• Lead external audits and maintain ongoing audit readiness

Revenue & Cash Integrity

• Oversee cash reconciliations across bookings, leases, and multiple payment methods

• Maintain strong financial controls over bank accounts, cash, and owner-facing reporting

Operational Transformation & Automation

• Audit and redesign workflows to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability

• Streamline monthly close, reporting, and FP&A processes to increase speed and insight

FP&A, Strategic Growth & Capital

• Lead budgeting, rolling forecasts, and cash flow planning at property and corporate levels

• Partner on fundraising, debt refinancing, and strategic capital initiatives

• Model new fee structures, contract economics, and growth initiatives to maximize profitability

Team & Stakeholder Leadership
